svg.text: 5 keys to safer food + danger zone

g.text: Cooked food out >2 h (1 h in heat!) = SUSPECT — reheat steaming ONCE or discard. Cool fast
(shallow pans, stir); fridge crowded = warm spots; leftovers dated + 2-day rule; baby food
fresh each feed (M03!). Flies = faeces couriers — cover ALL food, always.
FOODBORNE HITS: diarrhoea/vomiting hours after feasts (staph/B. cereus) · typhoid
(fever + headache + rose spots — water/food + carriers!) · cholera (rice-water + shock — ORS +
refer FAST!) · hepatitis A/E (jaundice + dark urine) · worms (soil + raw veg + bare feet!) ·
aflatoxin (mouldy groundnut/maize — LIVER CANCER: dry + sort + discard mouldy!).
OUTBREAK RESPONSE: treat (ORS/zinc/antibiotics per protocol) + trace (common meal? vendor?
water?) + notify (disease control — cholera/typhoid = IDSR!) + fix source (vendor pause +
water chlorinate + community alert) + document + follow-up. Nurses detect clusters at OPD.
VENDOR/CHOP-BAR CHECKS: medical fitness + handwash + hair covered + clean water + covered
food + waste binned + toilets near + no sick-handler cooking. Counsel (don't only punish!):
"covered + fresh + hot = customers + health". Liaise environmental health officers.
HOSPITAL KITCHENS: same 5 keys + therapeutic diets labelled + allergens flagged (M04!) +
immunocompromised extra-care + audits (PRO-II M4: swab + temp-log + train).
WATER: boiled/filtered/chlorinated where unsafe; stored covered + narrow-neck + tap; cups
clean; sachet/bottled checked (FDA!). "Water chain" taught at every diarrhoea case: source →
carry → store → serve — germs enter at EVERY link unguarded.
Exam line: \"clean, separate, cook, chill, safe-raw — 2 hours out, reheat once or out.\"
